n-up.text: Rule for every progress display: a bar only moves when the source reports movement. No percentage reported means an indeterminate bar that says so. An estimate appears only after real samples and is labelled as an estimate.

n-ent.text: Each entity kind gets the same three things at phone size: a 56 px row, a detail sheet whose first control is the one thing people do most with that kind, and a tile. The check walks every kind in the source's own list.

n-dr.text: A draft never runs. The live automation changes only on Save. The status line is quiet text, not a banner.

n-bf.text: Asked for by the owner: a backup before Core, Supervisor and operating system updates only, with the others free to skip it. One choice, three options, and each kind can still be set by hand.

n-cam.text: From the owner's phone: a cloud camera refused the stream for too many requests, and the message covered the header with the Live chip on top of it. A message belongs in the picture area, covers nothing, and the sheet never asks the provider again by itself while it is being limited.

n-ev.text: From the owner's phone: two doorbell events each offered Play, nothing had been saved, and Play answered that there is no recording. A row may only offer Play when a clip is really on disk. A camera that streams only through its provider is recorded around each event, by the home itself, and the page says so plainly.
